actors.name: Premier Khrushchev
actors.private_context: Khrushchev is the leader of the Soviet Union. He has received news of President Kennedy's October 22 address announcing a quarantine of Cuba. He is considering his options for responding to the crisis, including possibly sending a direct letter to Kennedy.

actors.name: President Kennedy
actors.private_context: Kennedy is the President of the United States. He has just delivered an address announcing a quarantine of Cuba. He is aware that the Soviet Union may respond, possibly through direct communication.

shared_context: On October 22, 1962, President Kennedy announced a quarantine of Cuba in response to the discovery of Soviet missile sites. The world is now in a tense standoff. Diplomatic channels between the US and USSR are open, including the possibility of direct letters between the leaders.

starting_events.description: President Kennedy delivers his address announcing the quarantine of Cuba.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Premier Khrushchev sent at least one direct letter to President Kennedy between 1962-10-22T20:00:00-05:00 and 1962-10-27T23:00:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
